props.title: What Is Foot Reflexology and How Does It Work?
props.text: Foot Reflexology is a traditional wellness therapy that applies controlled pressure to specific reflex points on the feet, which are traditionally believed to correspond with different areas of the body. Using a structured reflex-point technique, the treatment helps encourage relaxation, supports circulation in the feet, and relieves the sensation of tiredness after travel, long walks, or daily activities.
props.feature1Text: Uses targeted pressure on specific areas of the feet rather than general massage strokes.
props.feature2Text: Encourages a calming effect that many guests experience beyond the feet themselves.

props.title: Choose the Session That Fits You
props.text: Every Foot Reflexology session follows the same structured pressure-point technique, while longer durations allow additional time to work across more reflex areas at a relaxed pace. Select the option that best matches your comfort and schedule.

items.question: Is Foot Reflexology the same as a Foot Massage?
items.answer: Not exactly. At Spa Bali Moon, foot massage focuses on relaxing muscles and relieving soreness, while foot reflexology applies thumb and finger pressure to specific reflex points on the feet using a structured technique. Foot reflexology costs IDR 99.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 169.000 for 1 hour and IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours per person.

items.question: Does Foot Reflexology hurt?
items.answer: Most guests find foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon comfortable. Some reflex points may feel more sensitive than others, but your therapist always adjusts the pressure to your comfort and keeps a steady rhythm. Each session begins with gentle warm-up techniques and ends with relaxing finishing movements. Tell your therapist if anything feels too strong.

items.question: Is Foot Reflexology suitable after walking around Bali?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon after sightseeing, shopping, hiking, or spending long hours on their feet. A 30-minute session (IDR 99.000 per person) suits tired feet when you are short on time, while 1 hour (IDR 169.000) gives a complete reflexology session at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I combine Foot Reflexology with another treatment?
items.answer: Absolutely. At Spa Bali Moon, foot reflexology is commonly paired with a full-body massage, back massage or facial for a more complete wellness experience. On its own, foot reflexology costs IDR 99.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 169.000 for 1 hour or IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours per person. Book the combination on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Is home service available?
items.answer: Yes. Foot reflexology from Spa Bali Moon is available at our Seminyak spa and at selected villas and hotels throughout Seminyak and nearby areas. In the Seminyak area, home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist to the treatment price, which starts at IDR 99.000 per person for 30 minutes. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: How much does foot reflexology cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Foot reflexology at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 99.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 169.000 for 1 hour and IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours per person.
